ns2:course.label: Advanced Cellular Microbiology
ns2:course.description: Advanced primary literature-based discussion course on cellular microbiology and underlying infectious diseases. Graduate level companion course for MCB 429. Prerequisite: Concurrent or prior enrollment in MCB 429 or consent of instructor.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Prerequisite: Concurrent or prior enrollment in MCB 429 or consent of instructor.
